text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position stated early and returned to at the end","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay presents a direct, sustained stance against driverless cars and keeps that position visible throughout."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on awareness, laziness, control, safety, and cost","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its ideas into distinct body points that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"when a person needs to change lanes on a busy highway...\"","quality":"supporting development","description":"The essay explains its claims with fuller reasoning and concrete examples rather than relying mostly on summary."},{"evidence":"\"who is to blame for accidents\" and \"not safe enough to be on the roads\"","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay incorporates multiple article-based concerns and uses them to support its argument against the cars."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph beginning \"Some people would have to agree...\"","quality":"counterargument","description":"The essay acknowledges the opposing view and responds to it instead of ignoring it."},{"evidence":"\"Some people would have to agree upon the fact...\" followed by rebuttal","quality":"persuasive balance","description":"The essay weighs benefits and drawbacks before reaffirming its own position, which makes the argument feel more deliberate."}]}
